events.title: Brick Club
events.description:
Looking for a fun, affordable way to connect with your kids after school? Bring the whole family to the Big Sports Hall at the Community Centre every Tuesday during term time from 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM!

This is an interactive group where parents and primary school children (Reception/Year 0 to Year 6) team up!

Together, we will explore a great Bible story, enjoy some tasty snacks and drinks, and take on epic Lego team-building challenges. Come explore faith, build cool creations, and spend quality time together.

events.title: Vicarage Breakfast
events.description:
An opportunity to come and hang out at the vicarage and embrace the chaos, with all ages welcome.

Drop in anytime from 9:30am to enjoy a cuppa and a pastry with us as you begin your weekend.

events.title: Women's Card Making Social
events.description:
Join us for a festive Christmas Card Making Evening using a selection of beautiful Stampin' Up! products.

Enjoy a relaxed and creative evening making 3 handmade Christmas cards while learning and trying out different stamping, colouring, embossing and paper-crafting techniques. Whether you're an experienced crafter or completely new to card making, you'll be guided through each project and have plenty of opportunity to add your own creative touches.

Tickets cost £10 a person (please bring cash on the night) and numbers are limited so sign up soon.

There will also be some extra card kits, glue, Christmas cards etc for people to purchase on the evening, so please bring cash.

For women aged 16+.
